messages:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduled migration MIG-298 tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. DDL: add profile_flags to user_profiles + online backfill. Plan: canary on tenant range 0-10, rate-capped backfill, monitor locks/lag. I'll kick off via deploybot. Need canary owner + SRE watch. Pin service binary to v3.2.1 for the window. @alex you available for canary?

alex: I can take canary and watch for client errors. I'll be on from 00:20 UTC. Will watch 5xx, latency, and app logs.

deploy-bot: deploybot: MIG-298 queued for canary-1 at 00:30 UTC. Command: `/deploy MIG-298 --canary=1 --tenant-range=0-10 --pin=v3.2.1`

maria: quick q — what's our explicit rollback trigger list? replication lag threshold? lock waits?

jamie: Rollback criteria (explicit): 
- sustained lock_waits > 4k/s for >2m
- replication lag > 10s for >3m
- write error rate > 0.5% over 5m
- canary app 5xx spike or severity alerts from SLO checks
If any of the above hit, abort global rollout and run rollback playbook. Canary failure -> immediate stop.

kevin-sre: I'll add temporary alerts/dashboards. Also will apply a temporary backfill ratecap override (5rps/shard) if locks climb. Oncall will monitor replica lag and tombstone compaction.

sophia: If backfill stalls we can switch to sampling mode (reduce to 10% of keys) to unblock and still get telemetry. Add a feature-flag toggle `profile_flags_backfill_sampling` controlled by release team.

alex: Confirming: canary range 0-10, 30m observation with zero critical regressions before global. I'll post canary verdict in this thread at +30m.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary-1 started 00:31 UTC, applying DDL on shard-a. Observed brief KV lock, paused 36s, resumed. Backfill process launched with rate=3rps (config: `backfill.max_rps=3`). Logs: `apply_ddl: OK`, `backfill: started`.

jamie: Good. If anything noisy after DDL, prefer to reduce backfill rate before rolling back. Keep release pinned to v3.2.1 until end of window.

maria: Copy — I'll prepare rollback note snippets and a short release-notes blurb to post to #release-notes when canary succeeds.

jamie: Summary: MIG-298 tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. Canary owner: alex. SRE monitor: kevin-sre. Rollback criteria listed above. Feature-flag + sampling toggle ready. I'll update deploy status and post release notes after canary verdict. :thumbsup:
